title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(谷口昌宏研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Taniguchi Masahiro)
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn the fundamentals of chemistry (physical chemistry, inorganic solid chemistry, analytical chemistry). (2) plan and perform experiments by themselves. (3) discuss the results to help with further experiments. (4) prepare a report and make a presentation.
advice: This is the third course of Design Project in the Division of Applied Chemistry. The following material will be covered: 1. Surface analyses of materials using an atom probe technique. Instrumentation involved in the atom probe technique Program development and data analyses using mass spectrometry 2. A weekly seminar to introduce newly published research and give presentations of project activities. Instruction of the operation and handling of high-voltage, high-temperature vacuum instruments will be given. Students are expected to follow all instructions given in the laboratory.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of experiments in physical chemistry, inorganic chemistry, analytical chemistry.

activityGoals.body: Be able to work on a research project following the design project scheme.
Be able to write reports on the results and prepare and make a presentation.
Be able to explain the theory behind vacuum instruments and operate the instruments safely.
Be able to explain the properties of functional materials and their analysis methods.
